name: My Shark: VR Adventure
summary:
🦈 Your VR buddy - closer and more lifelike than ever! ✨
💓 This adorable little creature isn’t just a virtual pet - it’s your personal shark-friend who responds to gestures, hand movements, and touch. It wiggles its tail, swims over for attention, begs for treats, and reacts with endless charm. 💕
🥰 Feed your Shark, play mini-games in immersive VR, help it grow, unlock new emotions, and watch as it becomes your true underwater bestie. 🌊✨

FEATURES of My Shark: VR Adventure:
🎮 FULL VR IMMERSION
